{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Count internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_count}')

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue:.2f}')

# Output the values explicitly so they are in the evidence
print(internal_test_count)
print(total_revenue)"}
